observed_reality: PR558, PR560 and PR561 promotion workflows used github.sha/GITHUB_SHA under pull_request and therefore tested the synthetic merge commit rather than the reviewed PR head.
PR561 prior evidence explicitly recorded event_head_sha=181a2f95619faf3ac471a259573a54e78acc848a and tested_sha=fa5d087b91a4d2c5d3cf21ebaf06c8a8ec340e67.
GitHub primary documentation states that pull_request GITHUB_SHA is the merge-branch merge commit and github.event.pull_request.head.sha identifies the PR head.
grf.generated_reality: A shared event-to-tested-identity selector can restore promotion provenance if pull_request requires a non-empty PR head SHA, fetches exactly that SHA, and asserts tested_sha equals expected_pr_head; non-PR events may retain GITHUB_SHA.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: Changing the selector may still leave YAML/shell defects, runner failures, stale branch composition, or artifact omissions; a code patch alone is not evidence that the exact reviewed heads passed.
grf.discriminating_falsifier: Each repaired pull_request run must execute on its current PR head and persist expected_pr_head == tested_sha. Any mismatch, zero-step run, YAML failure, or missing evidence leaves exact-head promotion OPEN.
